operator_notes: No radio, no bench hardware, no operator: both stacks ran on the vehicle SBC (192.168.12.176) over a local leafnode, per docs/plan/PHASE4.md -> P4.6.

The pit stack's published ports were remapped (4222->14222, 8222->18222, 5432->15432) because the vehicle nats already owns those ports on a single-host run. Nothing else about either stack was changed.
ntrip-client was scaled to 0: no NTRIP credentials, and RTK plays no part in a replay.

This is the second run of the package. The first used rmc_sentence's 4-decimal arc-minute coordinate fields, which quantised replayed positions to 0.185 m and cost p50 1.2 ms of lap-time agreement; the encoder was widened to COORD_DECIMALS=9 and the run repeated from a clean slate. Numbers here are the second run's.

During the first run the docker daemon restarted and stopped every container. The ingest-writer resumed from its durable cursor and completed with no gaps, no duplicates and no re-publish. The run recorded here completed in one process and reached identical totals.

code.note: the run used the working tree that this branch's encoder-widening commit contains

pipeline.signal_source_mode: --gps-trace only (no CAN, no NMEA file); the legacy corpus carries decoded values, not raw frames

clock.method: none — no shared time reference is available or needed
clock.note: tools/replay.py stamps samples from the replaying host's clock, so the run sits at a constant wall-clock translation of June 2025. The offset is fitted by tools/compare_timing.py and the residual after removing it is reported as the crossing-time agreement.

radio.configuration: none — P4.6 crosses no radio; the leafnode ran over the host's loopback/bridge

infrastructure.vehicle_server_config: deploy/nats/vehicle.conf (JetStream domain veh, leafnode listener on 7422, TLS)
infrastructure.pit_stack: deploy/pit-compose.yaml (nats, timescaledb, mosquitto, migrate, provision-streams, ingest-writer, live-decoder, session-control)

database.co_timed_sample_rows: 768, all lap.event — the sector-3 completion and the lap completion share one interpolated instant by design

artefacts.note: raw run data is local and gitignored; these are the paths it lives at

result.note: residuals are 1-6 float64 ulp at unix-epoch magnitude (ulp(1.75e9) = 2.384e-07 s)
